objective: One portable native ARM64 Linux package using a glibc 2.35 baseline and bundled Qt/FFmpeg; reuse Linux backends and retain DEB behavior
status: preview host media and Ubuntu 24.04 updater passed; final artifact matrix pending
completionPolicy: Build, syntax, isolated logic and linkage checks are gates. Testing requires the exact shipped archive through real GUI workflows with independent received-media decoding.

build.distribution: Ubuntu 22.04.5 ARM64, user-owned Ubuntu Base via Bubblewrap on native Jetson CPU
build.cpu: NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano, six Cortex-A78AE cores

distribution.format: extract-and-run tar.gz with AppRun; no installation or FUSE
distribution.bundled: Qt plugins, FFmpeg helper and media libraries, Pulse/PipeWire clients and modules, application dependencies; per-file hashes and dependency notices
distribution.host: loader, glibc, C++/GCC runtimes, graphics drivers, desktop/portal, audio and Secret Service daemons
distribution.policy: GPL-enabled portable Linux bundle supported; nonfree bundle rejected. Existing DEB, Windows and Mac policy retained. Architecture and package format both gate update selection.

profile.video: native libx264 software H.264 at 4000 kbps
profile.audio: mixed system and microphone stereo, AAC 128 kbps
profile.qualification: owned Xvfb/xfwm4, virtual Pulse sources, independent host FFmpeg decoding; not physical desktop/device or performance qualification
